name: recovery
title: L. Recovery and resilience
description: Controlled failures inside the sandbox only: one worker type stopped while jobs queue, all workers paused to build a backlog, the dispatcher restarted while durable outbox events exist, graceful worker shutdown mid-load, a hard-killed worker (lease recovery) and a short pause of the ForgeCart database container. After each, the backlog must drain and every effect must be exactly once.
